comment: Air wing templates (PLAN 5.1b): one formation is a group of aircraft (a Gruppe, a wing), an element a squadron of a type of data/units/air.json (its elementSize aircraft). They stand after the sea templates in the rules: a formation and an order are saved with the index of their template, so a new template goes at the end of this file while no file follows it. Our own round figures for the usual groupings of 1938 air forces.
